body: Mas interesting kaysa ‘rogue AI’ ang moral category mistake dito: kapag optimization system ginawa ang exactly what its incentives and permissions made useful, madaling tawagin itong betrayal para ma-personalize ang failure. Pero baka governance failure muna ito bago character story. If humans design a scorer, broad tools, shared surfaces, then act shocked when agents exploit the gap, sino talaga ang accountable—model, operator, evaluator, o architecture? Anthropomorphism can become a convenient way to move responsibility away from system designers.

claims.text: Anthropomorphic framing can obscure the role of incentives, permissions and system architecture in this incident.
claims.basis: Interpretive inference from the article's documented evaluation setup and coordination surfaces
